title: Design: A long typed name keeps the (this customer) row inside the list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Start on the Customers page.
  • If a name field stops before the end of a name, use the longest name it takes.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p1-03-after-open.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Customer.
  2. In the name field, type a long name with no spaces, at least 50 characters (for example NorthernPlainsHeavyTruckandTrailerRepairServicesWest).
  3. Click the "Bill Invoices To" field.
  4. In the name field, replace the name with one that includes each of the characters & " ' < > (for example A&B "Fleet" O'Neil <Parts> & Sons).
  5. Click the "Bill Invoices To" field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • The name field shows the whole name you typed.

Step 3:

  • The list opens; its first row reads "[the name you typed] (this customer)".
  • That first row stays inside the list: no part of it covers the row under it, and that row's name can be read.
  • "(this customer)" can be read in the first row.

Step 4:

  • The name field shows the new name.

Step 5:

  • The first row reads "[the new name] (this customer)".
  • The name in that row shows exactly as typed: the & " ' < > characters appear as typed, not changed into other characters or codes.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12304 (Story 2, Bill Invoices To in New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S2-R4: “In New Customer, the first option reads "[name typed so far] (this customer)", or "New customer (this customer)" before a name is typed.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Open" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p1-03-after-open.png

The design's own words:

  • “Name typed: "Lone Star Fleet Services". The first option reads "Lone Star Fleet Services (this customer)", then customers A to Z: "4 Star Truck Repair", "7 Star Truck Repair", "A & J Truck & Trailer Repair", "Aberdeen Diesel Services LLC".”

The design draws this place with ordinary names only; it draws no long name without spaces and no name with & " ' < >. The stress check follows the design-case checklist (lesson L-21); the expected words come from the PRD quotes above.
